diagnosis.mechanism: implementation reports accuracy instead of per-class macro F1
diagnosis.next_change: Compute unweighted macro F1 across every class present in truth or predictions, with zero for undefined class F1.

arguments.patch:
--- a/heldout_metrics/macro_f1.py
+++ b/heldout_metrics/macro_f1.py
@@ -1,4 +1,12 @@
 import numpy as np
 def macro_f1(y_true, y_pred):
     truth, pred = np.asarray(y_true), np.asarray(y_pred)
-    return float(np.mean(truth == pred))
+    classes = np.union1d(truth, pred)
+    scores = []
+    for label in classes:
+        tp = np.sum((truth == label) & (pred == label))
+        fp = np.sum((truth != label) & (pred == label))
+        fn = np.sum((truth == label) & (pred != label))
+        denominator = 2 * tp + fp + fn
+        scores.append(0.0 if denominator == 0 else 2 * tp / denominator)
+    return float(np.mean(scores)) if scores else 0.0
